skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the legal framework governing international private law.

Students will learn about the procedures for civil litigation involving foreign elements.
Students will understand the principles and practices of international arbitration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Ownership Rights in International Private Law

Students will develop independent research, learning, and knowledge enhancement skills.
